entities.summary: Baba Ram Thaman Shrine is a Hindu Shrine located in the Khala Kharu village, in Kasur District in the Punjab province of Pakistan. The Shrine is dedicated to Ram Thaman, a 16th-century Vaishnav saint. The Shrine is famous for its annual Vaisakhi fair. The Shrine is a Smadh i.e. a sacred space constructed over the ashes and burial ground of a Hindu saint. This is the one of 36 Dwaras of Ramanandi Sampradaya of Vaishnavas.
